rules.instruction: Model classes: ApprovalHistory, Device, Repair, Staff. Enumeration types: (none). Preserve these model names exactly. Typed local helper and iterator names may be introduced; they are not new model elements.

Device.Contacts: Staff. This is a single-valued navigation. Navigate as an object; link assignment or clearing requires an explicit requirement. The declaration alone does not require creation, deletion, inverse updates, or a nonempty value.

Repair.History: Set(ApprovalHistory). This is a collection with element type ApprovalHistory. Use typed collection queries; link changes use the dialect membership forms only when required. The declaration alone does not require creation, deletion, inverse updates, or a nonempty value.

Staff.Boss: Staff. This is a single-valued navigation. Navigate as an object; link assignment or clearing requires an explicit requirement. The declaration alone does not require creation, deletion, inverse updates, or a nonempty value.
Parameter des: String. Reference it as des, not self.des; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter id: Integer. Reference it as id, not self.id; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter score: Integer. Reference it as score, not self.score; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter sid: Integer. Reference it as sid, not self.sid; preserve its declared name and type.
The operation returns Boolean. Use result only in the postcondition, with a compatible value satisfying the stated return obligation; do not assume a Boolean result is true.
